# CreaVerse

> A Pakistan-first learning universe for students, teachers, and creators — free courses, AI mentorship, VR lessons, and a directory of scholarships and contests.

CreaVerse helps learners from Matric and FSc through university and competitive exams, with a focus on underprivileged regions of Pakistan. It also curates global opportunities.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of CreaVerse and how it helps students and teachers.
- [About](/about): Mission, motto, and the story behind CreaVerse.
